title: Eric Davis's notes from the Advanced Physics Theoretical Working Group

tellings.quote: for me because Eric Davis had given me his notes from the advanced physics theoretical working group.

plain: The UFO researcher Grant Cameron says the physicist Eric W. Davis gave him his notes from the Advanced Physics Theoretical Working Group, a group that discussed unusual physics in the early 2000s. Cameron tells it first-hand and also mentions a person named Oke Shannon, and he treats the notes as an inside look at what such a group was weighing, tied to the papers of the astronaut Edgar Mitchell, including an alien autopsy document, and to an Army lab test of lift devices.
